pkgmetadata.longdescription:
Ryoku Desktop is the Gentoo packaging of the "ryoku" rice by neur0map: a complete Hyprland-based Wayland desktop built around a Quickshell shell, the Ryoku Hub settings surface, the Ryogami wallpaper daemon and a family of first-party helper apps (RyoVM, RyoStore, Rashin). It compiles the Ryoku.Blobs QML plugin, the livewall C daemon and every Go daemon/CLI, installs a branded compositor session entry, and lays a base configuration tree under /usr/share/ryoku/config that "ryoku materialize" copies into a user's ~/.config. This is the umbrella package; it pulls in the compositor, the shell runtime, fonts and the command-line tools the shell invokes by name.
Unlike the upstream Arch package it does NOT enable system services or run hardware tuners at merge time; see the post-install notes (readme.gentoo) for the manual steps.
This ebuild lives in an overlay and depends on packages that are not in the ::gentoo tree: the compositor stack (gui-wm/hyprland, gui-apps/quickshell, gui-apps/hypr*, x11-misc/matugen, app-misc/cliphist, app-misc/brightnessctl, gui-apps/fuzzel, gui-apps/wtype) and x11-themes/adw-gtk3 generally come from the guru and hyprland community overlays, and the fonts media-fonts/{otf-space-grotesk,fraunces,material-symbols-variable} are provided by this overlay. Not everything upstream ships has a Gentoo equivalent: the Hyprland compositor plugins the Hub Plugins page toggles, hyprland-preview-share-picker, gpu-screen-recorder and the mpv-mpris script are unavailable and the corresponding features degrade.

use.flag: Pull in net-wireless/bluez for the pill/Hub Bluetooth controls (Quickshell.Bluetooth over D-Bus, bluetoothctl) and install the Bluetooth A2DP-reset user unit and autosuspend modprobe drop-in.
Install the optional gaming stack the Ryoku Hub can toggle (gui-wm/gamescope, games-util/gamemode).

Patch the Hyprland autostart to auto-unlock KDE Wallet via kde-plasma/kwallet-pam (pam_kwallet_init) on session start. Enable if you keep KWallet instead of gnome-keyring; you must also wire pam_kwallet5.so into your login PAM stack.
Install the Ryoku stash-actions extension for gnome-base/nautilus (nautilus-python right-click menu).
Apply NVIDIA-specific session environment tweaks in the shipped Hyprland configuration (cursor and render workarounds). No extra package dependencies - drivers are a profile/kernel matter.
Enable the screenshot OCR / QR-scan pill feature (app-text/tesseract, app-text/tessdata_fast, media-gfx/zbar).
Pull in kde-plasma/plasma-integration so KDE apps (Dolphin, Kate) pick up the platform theme. Off by default since the session is leaving Plasma.
Install the Ryoku Plymouth boot theme and the ryoku-boot-apply helper. Only meaningful with a Plymouth-enabled initramfs.

Depend on a power-profile D-Bus service for the shell's power-mode UI, satisfiable by either sys-power/power-profiles-daemon or sys-apps/tuned built with its own ppd flag. Disable if you provide the interface another way.
Install the weston-based SDDM Wayland-greeter wrapper (dev-libs/weston, ryoku-greeter running weston --shell=kiosk). Not needed with greetd/ReGreet or GDM.
Pull in sys-auth/pam_u2f (pamu2fcfg) for the Hub FIDO2/U2F security-key enrollment flow.
Install RyoVM virtual-machine and GPU-passthrough support (app-emulation/qemu, app-emulation/libvirt, app-crypt/swtpm, OVMF, spice-gtk, xorriso).

Pull in app-shells/zsh and app-shells/zsh-syntax-highlighting that the shipped ryoku.zsh sources; the zsh dotfiles are always installed. (zsh-autosuggestions and zsh-history-substring-search are not packaged for Gentoo and are skipped at runtime.)
